QuickImageView - Distribution package v0.1.0

Requirements
------------
- Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
- Windows Imaging Component (included with Windows)

Usage
-----
Run QuickImageView.exe. The original image is never overwritten.
Use the File menu or Ctrl+O to select an image.

Distribution files
------------------
- QuickImageView.exe
- readme.txt / readme_jp.txt
- history.txt / history_jp.txt
- LICENSE.txt / LICENSE_jp.txt
